Nina (Marketing): Hey runtime — need a compact benchmark pack for next week's launch blog and webinar. Hoping for reproducible numbers we can cite and a short README for press kit. :memo:
Omar (Growth): Key asks: p50/p95 latencies, tokens/sec, est $/1k tok, and one hero transcript each for code and chat. Also want a sanitized CSV and a 'press-ready' one-row KPI table.
Jay (eng-runtime): OK. What models/variants and traffic shape?
Nina (Marketing): Models: redwood-open-1.2 (fp16 + q4_0) and community-70b (int8) if feasible. Traffic: light demo profile — 30 concurrent users, 5 minute steady run, mix 70% code completions (avg prompt 200), 30% chat (avg prompt 80).
Priya (eng-ml): For quality checks we'll run a 50-sample micro-eval for code correctness and a 50-sample semantic pass for chat. If quantized variant drops >6% on our metrics, flag it.
Jay (eng-runtime): Plan: batch_size=8, max_new_tokens=128, kv_cache=true. Collect p10/p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, CPU/GPU utilization samples, and raw timings per request. We'll produce raw CSV + sanitized CSV (remove prompt text).
Jay (eng-runtime): Also include reproduction scripts (curl + python snippet) and the exact runtime flags (kernel/cudnn/quant-backend).
Nina (Marketing): Perfect. Please include one-liner caveat for blog copy about synthetic vs prod traffic.
Omar (Growth): Also include a short note mapping our bench metrics to marketing claims, e.g., "~X ms median latency for 256-token completion" and what that means for typical users.
Priya (eng-ml): We'll generate a short diff doc showing token-level differences between fp16 and q4_0 for any notable regressions so marketing can explain tradeoffs.
Jay (eng-runtime): Kicked off job. bench-bot: queued (id jb-11223). Expect artifacts in ~2.5 hours.
bench-bot: jb-11223 -> running on shard-b (logs: https://internal-bench/jobs/jb-11223/logs).
Nina (Marketing): Deadline: need the sanitized CSV + one-row KPI table in #marketing by tomorrow morning 9am PT. Realistic?
Jay (eng-runtime): If run finishes cleanly, yes. If we see >10% run-to-run variance we'll run a 30m stability profile and update ETA. Will ping if that happens.
bench-bot: jb-11223 status: completed. Summary: 30 users, 5m, 3 variants. Results: https://internal-bench/jobs/jb-11223/results.zip
Jay (eng-runtime): Dropping sanitized CSV + KPI table now and tagging Nina/Omar. README includes methodology, cost calc formula, and the plain-English caveat: "Benchmarks use synthetic, controlled traffic; real-world results depend on prompt mix and concurrency."
Nina (Marketing): Amazing, thanks! We'll assemble slides and ping if we need reruns for different prompt mixes.
Omar (Growth): If possible, include a tiny A/B note comparing q4_0 cost savings vs fp16 percent change — we might use that in the blog headline.
Priya (eng-ml): Added that to the README with sample numbers and the micro-eval summary.
Nina (Marketing): Great work, team :rocket:
